tables: SELECT n.nspname AS schema,c.relname AS name,c.relkind,c.relrowsecurity,c.relforcerowsecurity FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg\_%' ESCAPE '\' AND n.nspname <> 'information_schema' AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f') ORDER BY 1,2
columns: SELECT table_schema AS schema,table_name,column_name,ordinal_position,data_type,udt_schema,udt_name,is_nullable,md5(coalesce(column_default,'')) AS default_md5,is_identity,identity_generation,is_generated,md5(coalesce(generation_expression,'')) AS generation_md5 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema NOT LIKE 'pg\_%' ESCAPE '\' AND table_schema<>'information_schema' ORDER BY 1,2,ordinal_position
functions: SELECT n.nspname AS schema,p.proname AS name,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS args,p.prokind,p.prosecdef,p.provolatile,p.proconfig,md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) AS definition_md5 FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg\_%' ESCAPE '\' AND n.nspname <> 'information_schema' AND p.prokind IN ('f','p') ORDER BY 1,2,3
policies: SELECT schemaname AS schema,tablename,policyname,permissive,roles,cmd,md5(coalesce(qual,'')) AS qual_md5,md5(coalesce(with_check,'')) AS check_md5 FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname NOT LIKE 'pg\_%' ESCAPE '\' ORDER BY 1,2,3
triggers: SELECT n.nspname AS schema,c.relname AS tablename,t.tgname,t.tgenabled,md5(pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,true)) AS definition_md5 FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg\_%' ESCAPE '\' AND n.nspname <> 'information_schema' AND NOT t.tgisinternal ORDER BY 1,2,3
extensions: SELECT e.extname,e.extversion,n.nspname AS schema FROM pg_extension e JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=e.extnamespace ORDER BY 1
